title: Pure Veda
summary: Pure Veda lore and control build, centering on Visas Starfrost's cosmic adversary Veda Kalanta and the Scale 0 Pendulum overlord Veda Kalarcanum. The archetype triggers from self-destruction cascades across the Starfrost universe, accumulating counters to summon a 4000 DEF tyrant that can skip the opponent's turn entirely.

summary.title: Starters
points: Clear New World destroys 1 face-up monster you control to Special Summon a monster with a different Type and Attribute and lower Level directly from your Deck, triggering destruction effects.
Peaceful Planet Calarium searches Mannadium Riumheart, Mannadium Meek, or Visas Starfrost on activation, and revives a destroyed LIGHT Tuner once per turn.
Mannadium Riumheart destroys a Mannadium monster or a monster with 1500 ATK/2100 DEF on field to Special Summon itself and search a Mannadium card.
Visas Starfrost destroys a monster you control with a different Type and Attribute to Special Summon itself from the hand, immediately fueling destruction triggers.
Visas Samsara counts as Visas Starfrost on field and in GY, and can recycle 2 Visas monsters from field, GY, or banishment to Special Summon itself as a Tuner or non-Tuner.
Scareclaw Reichheart Special Summons itself next to a monster in the Extra Monster Zone, and Reinforcement of the Army searches Riumheart or Reichheart.

summary.title: Opening: Riumheart + Calarium + Meek
steps: Activate Peaceful Planet Calarium to add Mannadium Meek from your Deck to your hand.
Normal Summon Mannadium Meek, then activate Mannadium Riumheart in hand, destroying Meek to Special Summon Riumheart.
Both Meek and Calarium trigger: Meek Special Summons another Meek from Deck (raising its Level to 4), and Calarium revives the destroyed Meek.
Place Veda Kalarcanum in your Pendulum Zone; each monster destruction places 3 counters on Kalarcanum.
Synchro Summon Visas Amritara using Riumheart and Meek; Amritara searches Clear New World or New World Stars from your Deck.
Activate Amritara to destroy a monster on your field, advancing Kalarcanum towards the 12 counters needed for its turn-skip summon.

summary.title: The Veda Overlords & Turn Skip
points: Veda Kalanta Special Summons itself from hand whenever a card on the field is destroyed by card effect and searches Clear New World; when another monster in your possession is destroyed, it destroys an opponent monster and gains its original ATK.
Veda Kalarcanum accumulates 3 counters in the Pendulum Zone every time a monster is destroyed, and removes 12 counters to Special Summon itself to the Monster Zone with 4000 DEF.

Veda Kalarcanum can banish 12 cards face-down from your hand, field, and/or GY as a Quick Effect when the opponent Special Summons from the Extra Deck to immediately skip the rest of their turn and jump to the End Phase.
Chaos Angel provides non-targeting banishment upon Synchro Summon and grants battle and activated effect immunity to your monsters using LIGHT and DARK materials.

summary.title: Extra Deck Payoffs & Traps
points: Visas Amritara is treated as Visas Starfrost on field, searches any Spell or Trap mentioning Visas Starfrost on Synchro Summon, and destroys 1 monster you control to boost Synchro Monsters by 800 ATK.
Vicious Astraloud banishes Visas Starfrost and a 1500 ATK/2100 DEF monster from field or GY to summon itself, destroying an opponent monster on summon and gaining half its ATK.
New World Stars revives a destroyed monster in Defense Position or searches a Visas Spell/Trap when a monster you control is destroyed while controlling Visas Starfrost.
New World Formation Sets a Spell or Trap mentioning Visas Starfrost directly from your GY and allows it to be activated the same turn.

allow.Mannadium Riumheart: Level 4 LIGHT Warrior that destroys a Mannadium or 1500 ATK/2100 DEF monster as a Quick Effect to Special Summon itself—immediately triggering Veda Kalanta in your hand AND placing 3 counters on Veda Kalarcanum!
allow.Mannadium Meek: Level 2 WATER Fairy Tuner that Special Summons another Mannadium Meek from your Deck whenever destroyed by Visas Starfrost, Riumheart, or Clear New World—providing repeated destruction triggers to charge Veda Kalarcanum to 12 counters on Turn 1!
allow.Peaceful Planet Calarium: Field Spell (searchable by Visas Amritara!) that searches Mannadium Riumheart or Visas Starfrost and revives destroyed Tuners once per turn to be popped again for Veda Kalanta and Veda Kalarcanum!
allow.Scareclaw Reichheart: Level 4 DARK Warrior (summonable from Deck via Clear New World!) that searches a Scareclaw Spell/Trap and links into Scareclaw Light-Heart.
allow.Reinforcement of the Army: Limited to 1 in TCG: searches Mannadium Riumheart or Scareclaw Reichheart.
allow.Terraforming: Limited to 1 in TCG: searches Peaceful Planet Calarium.
allow.Vicious Astraloud: Level 8 DARK Fairy Contact Fusion (banishes Visas Starfrost + 1 1500 ATK/2100 DEF monster from field/GY) that destroys 1 other monster on the field on Special Summon—triggering Veda Kalanta and Veda Kalarcanum!
allow.Scareclaw Light-Heart: Link-1 DARK Beast-Warrior summoned using Visas Starfrost or Scareclaw Reichheart that revives itself from the GY while Visas Starfrost is on the field.
allow.Chaos Angel: Level 10 Synchro boss summoned using Level 8 DARK Veda Kalanta + Level 2 Mannadium Meek or Level 6 LIGHT Visas Starfrost + Level 4 DARK Reichheart.

main: Veda Kalanta

Signature Level 8 DARK Warrior boss (2700 ATK): if a card(s) on the field is destroyed by card effect, Special Summons itself from your hand and adds 1 'Clear New World' from your Deck or GY to your hand; if another monster(s) in your possession is destroyed by card effect, targets 1 monster your opponent controls, destroys it, and gains its original ATK!
Veda Kalarcanum

Signature Scale 0 Level 12 DARK Warrior Pendulum boss (0 ATK / 4000 DEF): gains 3 counters in the Pendulum Zone every time a monster(s) is destroyed, and removes 12 counters to Special Summon itself; once per turn, when your opponent Special Summons from the Extra Deck (Quick Effect), banishes 12 cards from your hand, field, and/or GY face-down to immediately SKIP their current turn (jumping straight to the End Phase)!
Visas Starfrost

Level 6 LIGHT Warrior Tuner: destroys 1 monster you control with a different Type/Attribute (Mannadium Meek!) to Special Summon itself from your hand—immediately triggering Veda Kalanta in hand and placing 3 counters on Veda Kalarcanum!
Visas Samsara

Level 4 WIND Fairy Tuner: treated as 'Visas Starfrost' on the field and in the GY; returns 2 Visas monsters from your GY/field/banishment to Special Summon itself and can be treated as a non-Tuner for a Synchro Summon.
Mannadium Riumheart
Destroys Mannadium Meek on the field as a Quick Effect to Special Summon itself, search a Mannadium card, and trigger Veda Kalanta + Veda Kalarcanum.
Mannadium Meek
Summons another Mannadium Meek from your Deck (and increases its Level by 2) whenever destroyed by battle or card effect—fueling 4+ destructions in a single turn to unlock Veda Kalarcanum!
Scareclaw Reichheart
Level 4 DARK Warrior (1500 ATK / 2100 DEF) that Special Summons itself next to Visas Starfrost and fuels Vicious Astraloud.
Clear New World

Core Normal Spell (searched from Deck or GY by Veda Kalanta AND Visas Amritara!): destroys 1 face-up monster you control (triggering Veda Kalanta's monster-pop and Veda Kalarcanum's counters!) to Special Summon 1 monster with a different Type/Attribute and lower Level directly from your Deck!
Peaceful Planet Calarium

Field Spell (searchable by Visas Amritara): searches Riumheart, Meek, or Visas Starfrost on activation, and revives a destroyed Tuner once per turn so you can destroy it a second time for Veda Kalarcanum!
New World Stars

Continuous Trap (searchable by Visas Amritara!): when a monster(s) you control is destroyed by battle or card effect while you control Visas Starfrost, revives 1 of those monsters in Defense Position or searches a Spell/Trap mentioning Visas Starfrost; and recycles 3 Spells/Traps from GY!
New World Formation
Normal Trap (searchable by Visas Amritara): targets 1 Spell/Trap in your GY that mentions Visas Starfrost (Clear New World!) and Sets it to your field so it can be activated the same turn!
Reinforcement of the Army
Limited to 1 in TCG: searches Mannadium Riumheart or Scareclaw Reichheart.
Terraforming
Limited to 1 in TCG: searches Peaceful Planet Calarium.
extra: Signature Level 8 LIGHT Warrior Synchro Tuner (1+ Tuners + 1 LIGHT monster; treated as 'Visas Starfrost' on field): when Synchro Summoned, adds ANY Spell/Trap that mentions 'Visas Starfrost' (Clear New World, Peaceful Planet Calarium, or New World Stars!) from your Deck to your hand; and destroys 1 monster you control during your Main Phase (triggering Veda Kalanta and Veda Kalarcanum!) to boost Synchro Monsters by 800 ATK!

Level 8 DARK Fairy Fusion boss (banishes Visas Starfrost + 1 1500 ATK/2100 DEF monster from field/GY): cannot be destroyed by battle, and targets 1 other monster on the field on Special Summon to destroy it (triggering Veda Kalanta and Kalarcanum!) and gain half its ATK!
Link-1 DARK Beast-Warrior summoned using Visas Starfrost or Scareclaw Reichheart.
Level 10 Synchro boss (Veda Kalanta + Mannadium Meek, or Visas Starfrost + Reichheart) that banishes a card on Summon and grants LIGHT + DARK protection.
